intro: Another Clue to Sanders' Treasure is a weathered parchment slip left behind by the notorious pirate Captain Sanders. Retrieved from an old barrel, it contains directional verse pointing fortune hunters toward a lonely landmark on the bluffs of Westfall.

sections.t: A Trail on the Coastal Bluffs
p: Captain Sanders was careful never to keep his stolen riches in plain sight. Instead of drawing a single map that could be seized at once, he split his instructions into a succession of riddles and buried markers. This scrap of parchment continues the trail, directing whoever holds it to turn north from the previous hiding place and seek out a discarded jug sitting near an isolated windmill towering over the sea cliffs.
